body: CHARADON, the wolf-father who founded the Doviello, called back from the dead by his shamans, leader of the Doviello in the fantasy game Fall from Heaven: human; male; old but still hugely powerful; massive and broad, nearly a giant. Weather-beaten pale skin, old pale claw scars across one cheek and both forearms, shaggy grey hair, a matted grey beard, cold yellow-grey wolf's eyes.
costume: black-dyed leather and dark iron scales with charcoal fur, and a belt of wolf teeth.
signature: His GREY WOLF-HEAD HOOD is always on him, the snarling wolf's head on top of his own and its pelt spilling over his shoulders.
extra: His face never moves, whatever he is doing: no snarl, no smile, no anger, mouth a flat line in the beard, his yellow-grey eyes level and unblinking like a wolf watching the weakest of a herd.

vibes.name: Wolf Father
vibes.line: Holding a wolf pup up by the scruff at eye level in his right hand, eyes on it, looking it over, his left hand heavy on its mother's head at his knee, more wolves pressing round his legs like children; a snowy pine clearing, soft grey morning, snow falling.
vibes.wears: a vast shaggy cloak of many grey wolf pelts sewn together, their tails still hanging at the hem, over a plain charcoal felt tunic.

vibes.name: Returned Dead
vibes.line: Slowly closing and opening his left hand before his face, testing grey fingers not quite alive, his right hand braced on the stone lintel of the barrow he has just left; eyes on the hand; frost in his beard and brows; green aurora over a midnight barrow field.
vibes.wears: his burial gear: ancient bronze scale armour gone green with age and rimed with white frost, grave goods of amber beads and bone amulets at his neck, a frozen hide shroud over one shoulder.

vibes.name: Blank Approval
vibes.line: Notching a tally stick in his left hand with a flint knife in his right, the blade biting into the wood, one notch per survivor; eyes level and empty, straight on the viewer, as if counting you next; a bare hilltop above a hide-tent camp, bleached noon glare.
vibes.wears: a hunter's plain undyed hide coat and leggings, laced with sinew and bleached pale by snow, a collar of grey hare fur, like the clothes he wore as a lost boy.

vibes.name: Strength Only
vibes.line: Tying a bleached horned beast skull onto the leaning standing stone among the others, pulling the rawhide knot tight with his right fist, his left hand gripping a huge stone maul over his shoulder; chin lowered, looking down at the viewer; a windswept ridge at red stormy dusk.
vibes.wears: a sleeveless hauberk of heavy blackened iron rings over oxblood leather, his huge scarred arms bare, thick iron torcs on his upper arms, a belt of wolf teeth.
